# Traffic Fall and Latency Rise in Sfax on Microwave Link LNK-SFX-02-A

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_degradation at `LNK-SFX-02-A`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence of major link degraded alarm matching the exact onset and recovery of KPI anomalies; maintenance, external events, and changes checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-23 12:15 to 2026-09-23 17:58
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-23 12:16
- **Affected:** S-SFX-004, S-SFX-007, LNK-SFX-02-A

## Summary

Transport degradation on microwave link LNK-SFX-02-A caused traffic to drop and latency to rise on dependent sites S-SFX-004 and S-SFX-007.

Traffic fell and latency rose on sites S-SFX-004 and S-SFX-007 starting at 2026-09-23 12:15 and recovering fully when the major link degraded alarm cleared at 2026-09-23 17:58.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-23 11:29: Software upgrade CHG-2026-0062 executed on AGG-SFX-02 [CHG-2026-0062]
- 2026-09-23 12:15: Earliest KPI anomaly onset detected with S-SFX-004 latency above baseline and traffic drop [T7, ALR-0025, ANM-000316, ANM-000314]
- 2026-09-23 12:16: Major LINK_DEGRADED alarm ALM-000468 raised on microwave link LNK-SFX-02-A [ALM-000468]
- 2026-09-23 17:58: Major LINK_DEGRADED alarm ALM-000468 cleared on microwave link LNK-SFX-02-A, ending the impact [ALM-000468]

## Evidence

- Sites S-SFX-004 and S-SFX-007 depend on microwave link LNK-SFX-02-A and aggregation router AGG-SFX-02 [T5, T6]
- Sites S-SFX-004 and S-SFX-007 experienced traffic volume drop and latency rise starting at 2026-09-23 12:15 [T7, ALR-0025]
- Microwave link LNK-SFX-02-A raised a major LINK_DEGRADED alarm from 2026-09-23 12:16 to 2026-09-23 17:58 [T8, ALM-000468]
- No external events occurred in region SFX during the incident window [T10]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_degradation** at LNK-SFX-02-A: confirmed. Major link degradation alarm ALM-000468 on LNK-SFX-02-A directly coincides with the traffic drop and latency rise on S-SFX-004 and S-SFX-007 from 12:15 to 17:58. [T7, T8, ALM-000468]
2. **bad_change** at AGG-SFX-02: rejected. Software upgrade CHG-2026-0062 occurred at 11:29, whereas KPI degradation started at 12:15 and the link alarm occurred at 12:16, making it unrelated to the transport link issue. [CHG-2026-0062, T7, ALM-000468]

## Ruled out

- CHG-2026-0062: Software upgrade on AGG-SFX-02 completed at 11:29, which precedes the 12:15 onset of KPI degradation and does not correlate with the LNK-SFX-02-A link degradation timing.
- ALM-000465: Warning TEMP_HIGH on S-SFX-001 cleared well before the incident window started and is unrelated to Sfax sites.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect microwave link LNK-SFX-02-A hardware and transmission path stability to prevent recurrence.

report.title: Traffic Fall and Latency Rise in Sfax on Microwave Link LNK-SFX-02-A

confounders.why: Harmless software_upgrade on AGG-SFX-02 46 min before the degradation; the sibling links under the same router were unaffected.

truth.notes: trap=change_on_root_node; Rain fade on microwave link LNK-SFX-02-A: throughput limited, sites stayed up. Trap: a software_upgrade on AGG-SFX-02, the router above the link, ran 46 min before the degradation, so a hasty investigator blames the router change. Settled by: (1) only the sites of LNK-SFX-02-A degraded, while the sites of LNK-SFX-02-B under the same router stayed normal, so a router change is not the cause; (2) the KPIs were normal between the change and the onset; (3) the major LINK_DEGRADED alarm is on the microwave link, whose signal fluctuates like weather rather than stepping; (4) it recovered without any rollback.
